blocks.text: IaaS basic computing infrastructure, jaise servers, storage aur networking, pay-as-you-go (jitna istemal utna paisa) ke hisaab se deta hai. Users ka operating systems, applications aur storage par control hota hai, lekin neeche ke physical (asal) infrastructure par nahi.
Misal (Example): Amazon Web Services (AWS) users ko apni applications chalane ke liye virtual servers kiraye par deti hai. Microsoft Azure aur Google Compute Engine bhi mashhoor IaaS providers hain.

blocks.prompt: IaaS ke virtual server par operating system kaun install aur sambhalta hai?
blocks.explanation: User. Provider sirf virtual hardware, storage aur network deta hai; operating system, applications aur storage ka control user ke paas hai.

items: IaaS: servers, storage aur networking kiraye par (pay-as-you-go).
OS aur apps user sambhalta hai; physical hardware provider (AWS, Azure, Google Compute Engine).
